---
name: Submit a New Joke
about: Propose a funny developer-centric 404 joke to be added to witty-404
title: '[JOKE]: '
labels: 'joke-submission'
assignees: ''
---

### Joke ID
*Must be unique, lowercase, and kebab-case (e.g. `k8s-pod-evicted`)*
```
your-joke-id
```

### Title
*1-3 punchy lines separated by line breaks*
```
Your request took off,
found nothing,
and did not survive re-entry.
```

### Subtitle
*Dev-relatable explanation of what went wrong (markdown bold/code formatting supported)*
```
The endpoint was deprecated during a refactor that was labeled "minor cleanup".
```

### Terminal Logs
*6-12 lines, each starting with `> `*
```
> checking if page exists...
> it does not.
> checking git blame...
> blaming the intern...
> intern quit in 2023.
> shipping anyway. 🚀
```

### Footnote
*Error code / diagnostic summary*
```
Error code: `MY-ERROR-404` · Root cause: *vibes*
```

### Emoji
```
✈️💥
```

### Suggested Tags
*(e.g., deploy, refactor, blame, legacy, meetings, database, frontend, backend, security, ai, git, devops, infra, dns, cache)*
```
deploy, refactor
```

### Path Roast Template (Optional)
*Sentence with `{path}` to roast missing URLs*
```
We looked for `{path}` everywhere. It is not here.
```
